decisions.decision: Environment content identity separate from installation receipt and ProjectIdentity
Monotonic generation CAS and atomic selector/receipt/intent transaction after durable capsule
Separate durable IdentityRoot and BootstrapKey reservation; never init over missing old journal
Launch prepared pin then project admission; terminal proof required for pin release
Offline exact closure plus independently bootstrapped trust; no latest or hidden fetch claim
Actual T03 source template and independent golden are mandatory release inputs; no alternate grammar
Source working head initially unaccepted; no install-triggered normative acceptance or deployment
Incomplete authority restoration preserves unknown debt and blocks writes; default tools not authority reset
